name: comqtt-listener-failure-supervision-and-recovery
instr:
comqtt cannot currently report listener lifecycle failures or perform controlled, bounded recovery across its broker and authenticated management APIs. Add transport-neutral status and recovery without changing listener ownership or shutdown semantics.

Every listener obtained through `listeners.New().Add(...)` and `Get(id)` must expose a coherent `Listener.Status` snapshot from `github.com/wind-c/comqtt/v2/mqtt/listeners`. Start in `ListenerStateIdle`; retain the registered identity, monotonic attempt number, current state, and latest outcome. Record exactly one classified completion per Serve attempt, and never let stale completions overwrite newer attempts. `RecoveryPolicy.MaxRestarts` bounds replacements after the initial attempt. Successful recovery returns to serving; exhaustion is terminal.

TCP, Unix-socket, QUIC, Websocket, HTTPStats, HTTPHealthCheck, Net, and MockListener must follow this lifecycle while preserving constructors, callbacks, close results, and resource ownership. Stream, connection, frame, and upgraded-connection failures are not listener failures. HTTP-only listeners never produce MQTT establishment callbacks. Never replace a supplied `NewNet` endpoint. Keep `NewMockListener` failures and callback ordering deterministic.

`Server.ListenerStatuses` from `github.com/wind-c/comqtt/v2/mqtt` must return one coherent, listener-ID-sorted snapshot, including several concurrently changing listener types. `Rest.GenHandlers` from `github.com/wind-c/comqtt/v2/mq
